baseline.interpretation: Actual original CLI help/refusal plus unchanged native API/client fixture control; no installed-package or HTTPX execution.

first_fixture.failure: Receiver's old whoami expectation omitted the unchanged native mode/base_url/profile wrapper. All planner, error and parser cases passed; production source was not changed.

corrected_control.scope: Only corrected the expected native whoami wrapper and reran that case. The initial failed receipt and original receiver remain exact.

current_composition.scope: Exact current API and composed CLI source compiled in one native-client fixture child. New native quizzes and list_files behavior preserved. Current planner blocks equal previously received blocks; all API source outside the native list_files change is exact.

local_disposition: PASS for the preserved planner dispatch/output/cleanup and stated native-fixture composition; counts above describe distinct executions and are not an asserted fresh full-suite rerun.

real_package_http_tests.status: Source parses; not executed locally because declared HTTPX/MCP dependencies are absent. Existing hosted CI is required before integration.

limits: Full exact CLI source is compiled in each actual Python -I -B -S child; actual_cli_children reports the selected count.

When compiled_api_source is present, that full exact API source is compiled before CLI execution; native_support records the retained on-disk files and unchanged client/helpers. Otherwise the API is imported from those files.
Package __init__/bundle/MCP and installed entry points are not executed.
HTTPX is only an import/exception adapter with every other attribute forbidden.
Error propagation uses explicit native exception injection; real HTTP, token/session transport and Link pagination are separate tests.
No network, GUI, provider, file mutation or live Canvas effect was admitted.

primary_reference.semantics: Existing planner GET, optional native start/end date values, supplied personal/course items and planner_override; no writes or local reinterpretation.
